ReleaseNotes: Added automatic Parent DB health monitoring every 5 mins, clear SQL connection polls on failure and retries.
Added Parent DB connection testing to Admin-> System Health for manually verifying live Parent DB connectivity.
Added Backup Now to the Parent DB Cache snapshot card so admins can create a fresh cache snapshot on demand.
Added an API Restart control so System Health, including password-protected server-side restart support for admins
Improved Parent DB outage handling so cached site data remains available when live Parent DB access is unavailable.
Added Field Tech task notifications with a navigation badge and sounds when tasks are recieved.
Field Tech task notifications are Daily Assignments only (Does not include the Lineman Role).
Improved Field Tech History search by extending search bar debounce and auto focus of the caret after search results refresh.
Improved Submit Write-Up crew participation. All crew members are checked by default with the option to remove a tech from write-up, tech history and site history.
Improved Dispatch pane refreshing so Tickets, Tasks, Daily Assignments, and Technicians refresh automatically when opened.
Fixed Daily Assignment carry-over behavior including multi-crew assignment scenarios.
Improved technician availability display so off-duty techs are shown appropriately on Daily Assignments Pane.
Updated Dispatch Tickets double-click to Edit Ticket instead of the Details Pane. Details pane is still accessible by clicking the "Open Details" button.
Limited Tower View pings so only one tower sector can run manual pings at a time. Starting pings on another sector automatically stops the currently active sector pings.
Improved Dispatch task notifications and sounds.
Improved several Admin and System Health workflows and navigation layouts.
UI polish on several of the Admin panes.
